steps.name: Audit Current Workflow Classification
steps.description: Trace how promoted backlog items are assigned `level`, `workflow_profile`, route hints, and quick/standard gates. Identify why this level 3 workflow task was promoted as quick.
steps.acceptance: Findings identify the responsible code paths and include a failing or documented reproduction for high-level promoted work misclassified as quick.

steps.name: Define Project-Intake State And Artifact Model
steps.description: Define the MVP state model for project intake, including source capture, analysis, brief, spec/architecture evidence, plan, confirmed decomposition, and blocked states.
steps.acceptance: A concrete schema/file layout decision exists, including where project-intake artifacts live and how source provenance is represented.

steps.name: Define CLI Command Contract
steps.description: Decide and document the CLI surface for project-intake MVP, preferring a distinct project namespace unless implementation evidence shows a profile extension is safer.
steps.acceptance: Command contracts cover capture, analyze/brief generation guidance, plan, and backlog conversion, including inputs, outputs, errors, and no-network behavior.

steps.name: Implement Project-Intake Capture
steps.description: Add the capture route for text/markdown source materials and source references. Store source inventory and initial metadata in the chosen artifact model.
steps.acceptance: Users can create a project-intake item from content or files; CLI output reports canonical artifact paths and next action.

steps.name: Implement Analysis And Brief Guidance
steps.description: Add deterministic routing and prompt-payload generation for requirements, product, UI/UX, technical, risks, and open-questions analysis, plus project brief writing.
steps.acceptance: CLI can guide or persist project-intake analysis/brief artifacts without hidden LLM execution and with clear missing-evidence errors.

steps.name: Implement Confirmation And Decomposition Gates
steps.description: Add gates that prevent implementation, milestone planning, or backlog generation until the project-intake output is explicitly confirmed by the user.
steps.acceptance: Unconfirmed intake cannot generate executable backlog items; confirmed intake can generate or guide normal backlog items with provenance links.

steps.name: Integrate Routing With Next, Status, Check, And Closeout
steps.description: Update `docpath next --agent`, `status --agent`, `check`, and closeout guidance so project-intake states resume correctly and do not emit quick-task closeout hints.
steps.acceptance: Project-intake states produce coherent next actions; standard backlog and quick tasks keep their existing route behavior.

steps.name: Add Compatibility And Regression Tests
steps.description: Add tests for project-intake capture, readiness gates, artifact generation, confirmation behavior, backlog conversion, and existing backlog/quick compatibility.
steps.acceptance: Tests fail before implementation where appropriate and pass after implementation; existing backlog and quick test coverage remains green.

steps.name: Update Agent Protocol And Documentation
steps.description: Update agent-facing instructions and docs to explain when to use project-intake versus backlog, quick, analyze, spec, and plan flows.
steps.acceptance: Documentation clearly covers new-project inputs such as PPT-derived text, API docs, introductory docs, meeting notes, and single requirements documents.

steps.name: Run Quality Gates And Prepare Closeout
steps.description: Run the relevant test suite and `docpath check`, then summarize changed artifacts, known limitations, and follow-up work.
steps.acceptance: Quality gates pass or any residual failures are explicitly documented with owner and reason.
